title: Fixed Twin Crank Rewind and Inspection Bench
description: One newly authored complete fixed manual film rewind and inspection bench appearance. A whole low common bed on four finite feet supports two independent open bearing pedestals, two horizontal spindle shafts and two fixed outboard cranks with complete handgrips. Two upright double-flange reels have genuine open annular rims, rooted spokes, full hubs and separate stored-film exterior annuli. One continuous finite exposed ribbon connects both film masses over two separately rooted rollers and a central low inspection bridge with an opaque blank plate and narrow side retainers. Unlike a high projector case with elevated feed/take-up arms, lens and film gate, this is a broad two-ended manual workbench without a projection assembly. Unlike the inclined open-reel audio deck, it has independently vertical bearing pedestals and cranks, a central inspection bridge and no audio head/control console. All geometry newly authored, no old reel or machine meshes imported. One complete prop, zero scenes, no separately counted reels or bridge. Four opaque untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up, whole horizontal-envelope-centred ground origin. Static display only: film masses are exterior volumes, not individual wound layers; ribbon has no frames or sprocket perforations. No rewind/feed motion, tension, gearing, imaging, lighting, editing accuracy, audio/electrical function, compatibility, manufacture or machinery safety claimed.
